lines.text: Sl. 66. महाशैल &c.—शिलानां संघातः शिलासंघातः । महांश्चासौ शैलश्च
महाशैलः तस्य शिलासंघातः like a dense ( सं ) line ( घात ) of rocks
&c. The fig. here is उपमा, वत् the simile-expressing aff.
being omitted in the compound उत्पलकोमलम्. For a similar
idea, see sl. 63.
Sl. 67. नामापि न श्रूयते—even its name is not heard i. e. no
trace of it is left. ज्ञायते V. l. known i. e. through the medium
of the ears. मुक्ताकारतया—by reason of its assuming the form of
a pearl. स्वात्याम्–In Swâti i e. while the sun is in conjunction with
the constellation Svâti. It is supposed that at the time of the sun
coming in conjunction with this constellation the pearl-shells
burst open and the rain-drops that they receive into their cavity
form pearls; see Bṛhatsanmhitâ of Varâhamihira XV. 13. Cf.
पात्रविशेषे न्यस्तं गुणान्तरं व्रजति शिल्पमाधातुः । जलमिव समुद्रशुक्तौ मुक्ताफलतां
पयोदस्य ॥ Mâl. I. 6. सन्मौक्तिकम्—A good or faultless pearl. सत् is
evidently preferable to तत्. जायते–Since this verb is repeated a
strict rhetorician would detect in this कथितपददोष ( the fault of
repeating a word with the same meaning ). The reading—जुषां
&c. is free from this fault. The fig. is अर्थान्तरन्यास.
Sl. 68. Some take एव with भर्तुः. but that is not good; the
construction should be यद्भर्तुर्हितमेवेच्छति तत्कलत्रम्–meaning ‘she
that desires the good only of her husband deserves to be
called ‘wife.’ कलत्रम् Mark the gender of this word which is
neu.; the gender of Sanskrit words in some cases is quite
arbitrary as remarked by Pân.– लिङ्गमशिष्यं लोकाश्रयत्वाल्लिङ्गस्य । Cf.
the word दार which is masc., and is always used in
the plural. पुण्यकृतः—पुण्यं कृतवान् पुण्यकृत्. The aff. क्विप् ( ०—त् )
is added to कृ after the words mentioned in the Sûtra सुकर्म-
पापमन्त्रपुण्येषु कृतः । Pân. III. 2. 89.
Sl. 69. नम्रत्वेनोन्नमन्तः—rising to greatness by humility. ख्या-
पयन्तः—pres. p. of the causal of ख्या. Their appreciation of other
people’s merits is in itself a sign of their possessing merits.
वितत०—दूषयन्तः—rebuking. Contemptuous silence is the best
